title: Reworking wildlife behavior using real life studies
author: fapfap_ahh
selftext:
Spent a few iterations reworking the wildlife based on real life behaviour. As I playtested and went hunting for food, I noticed deer used to scatter everywhere and run right past bears when being hunted by a wolf. So went through some research and used it to ad more realism to their behavior:

* herds flee together on one escape route, stragglers get pulled back in. 
   * they only scatter when ambushed up close, then regroup.
* fleeing animals avoid every threat at once, so no more deer running from you straight past a bear.
* deer stop after the dash, look back at what spooked them, then walk off
* one deer freezing to look puts the whole herd on alert
* wolves fan out on the approach and all rush when the prey bolts. 
   * they go for the weakest one and give up fast if it fails
* predator packs feed around the kill together
* bears ignore healthy deer, but a panicked or wounded one running close gets a charge by the bear
* bears smell carcasses and come steal them, wolves back off
* animals look up at others running past
* wolves howl at rest now
